description: The net interest margin taken apart: each earning asset's balance, yield and contribution, each funding line's balance and cost, what moved the margin by volume and rate, history and peers, with each line's MDRM codes. (Source: FFIEC Call Report Schedules RI and RC-K (BankRegReports).) Dollar amounts are in thousands of US dollars ($000s); ratios are percentages.
